name: gpt-oss-120b
description:
Here is how to read the gpt-oss-120b config.json. The architecture class is GptOssForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 2,880: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 201,088 × 2,880: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_attention_heads is 64, so each head sees 64 dimensions (2,880 / 64). The ratio test is hidden_size / num_attention_heads = 2880 / 64 = 64. 64 is a multiple of 32 (NVIDIA warp-friendly), and a multiple of 16 (Huawei cube-friendly), and a power of two (Triton / FlashAttention-friendly). From this number alone you cannot name the training chip.

num_key_value_heads is 8, so this is grouped-query attention (GQA): 64 query heads share 8 key/value groups, so the KV cache is about 8× smaller than full MHA.

num_hidden_layers is 36: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 2,880. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 2,880-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

max_position_embeddings is 131,072 tokens — the context window in the config. rope_scaling is type yarn with factor 32.0, which stretches the rotary positions so the advertised window can be larger than the span the model originally trained on. rope_theta is 150000: that is the wavelength of the rotary embedding. A larger theta keeps distant tokens from aliasing after a full rotation.

vocab_size is 201,088. 201,088 is divisible by 128. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

tie_word_embeddings is false, so the input embedding matrix and the output LM head are separate learned matrices rather than a shared transpose.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/openai/gpt-oss-120b/blob/main/config.json.
